keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Bournemouth 1, Sunderland 0. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Evanilson.
Kevin Danso (Sunderland) is shown the red card.
António Silva (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Omar Alderete (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bournemouth 2, Sunderland 0. Evanilson (Bournemouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Delay in match because of an injury Evanilson (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sunderland. Habib Diarra replaces Tymur Tutierov.
Substitution, Sunderland. Luke O'Nien replaces Omar Alderete.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Justin Kluivert replaces Lewis Cook.
Chris Rigg (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sunderland. Jules Ahoka replaces Chris Rigg because of an injury.
Delay in match (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Álvaro Rodríguez replaces Evanilson.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Amine Adli replaces Marcus Tavernier.
Delay in match (Bournemouth).
Delay in match because of an injury Habib Diarra (Sunderland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Bafodé Diakité replaces Tyler Adams.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ben Gannon-Doak replaces Rayan.
Second Half ends, Bournemouth 2, Sunderland 0.
